title: MMM数据模型：去中心化知识共享的规范规范
summary: MMM是一种为知识文档设计的数据模型，结合少量规范约束与自由文本标签的灵活性，旨在跨学科、应用和部署实现互操作性，无需语义统一。参考实现和试点部署数据证明了其可实现性和早期可用性。
summary_en: MMM is a data model for knowledge documentation that combines a small set of normative constraints with the expressive freedom of free-text labels, designed for interoperability across disciplines, applications, and deployments without requiring semantic convergence. A reference implementation and pilot deployment data demonstrate implementability and early usability.
